GWM ORA 5 EV

REDEFINE YOUR NEW ERA

Powered by a 58.3 kWh battery and a high-efficiency 15-in-1 e-drive system, delivering up to 520 km (NEDC). Supports 120 kW DC fast charging and 6 kW V2L, with 360° Surround View and L2+ driver assistance for a safer, smarter drive.

NEW HAVAL H6

SMART SUV FOR THE MODERN JOURNEY

1.5T Plug-in Hybrid with EV mode up to 150 km* per one full charged, voice control, and Level 2+ intelligent driving system. Comfort, efficiency, and confidence in every ride, 8 speakers+1 subwoofer, Coffee OS 3.

EXPLORE NEW HAVAL H6

GWM WEY G9

THE CRAFTED MASTERPIECE

GWM WEY G9 is powered by a 1.5-liter turbocharged gasoline engine paired with dual electric motors, working in conjunction with the intelligent Dedicated Hybrid Transmission (DHT) system. It delivers a combined maximum output of 442 PS and 642 Nm of peak torque. The vehicle offers a pure electric driving range of up to 170 km (NEDC) and is equipped with a 58-liter fuel tank, providing a total driving range of over 1,000 km.
